This intrastate clash carries significant weight, as the winner secures a spot in the Sweet 16 in Houston. Both programs are currently 1-0 in the NCAA Tournament, with Houston advancing past Idaho and Texas A&M moving forward after defeating Saint Mary’s. Watch Texas A&M vs Houston on Sling TV. The game features a contrast in styles, pitting head coach Kelvin Sampson’s veteran Cougars against head coach Bucky McMillan’s aggressive system. While Texas A&M brings a motivated system to the court, the implied probabilities point toward the Cougars securing the victory. When is the Texas A&M vs Houston Game? What Time Does It Start? The neutral-site game between Texas A&M and Houston takes place on March 21, 2026. Tip-off is scheduled for 6:10 PM ET. Where Is the Texas A&M vs Houston Game? The matchup takes place at the Paycom Center in Oklahoma City, Oklahoma. For this neutral-site game, Houston is the designated home team, and Texas A&M serves as the designated away team. How Can I Watch the Texas A&M Aggies vs Houston Cougars Game? Viewers looking to tune in to this postseason contest can watch the game live on national television. The broadcast is carried exclusively on the TNT network. How Can I Stream the Texas A&M Aggies vs Houston Cougars Game? If you prefer a digital platform, you can stream the game directly using the Watch TNT app or the TNT website with a valid cable login. The broadcast is also available on the HBO Max streaming service for users with the sports add-on. For cord-cutters, several live TV streaming services carry TNT in their channel lineups. Check your specific package to ensure the network is included.
